Leave 12.2.3 open/unassigned until Rust Observe architecture/API and the canonical sequence-boundary decision land; then exercise registrations, multiple protected notifications with fresh responder PIVs, replay/ordering, cancellation/RST, context replacement, and errors across both production implementations.
ERRATUM: project-LICHEN-worker6-l1qw.7.11.4 is CLOSED, not open.
